```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dpi = 96,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "100%"
)
source(file.path("..", "..", "pkgdown", "validation-helpers.R"))
bundle <- load_validation_bundle()
counts <- bundle$manifest$counts
```

RSYC yield curves were validated against independent ground plots from
`r bundle$manifest$validation$reference`. Each curve was compared with the
plots located in its tile or ecological unit. Plots were grouped into
`r bundle$manifest$validation$age_class_width`-year age classes, and plots
older than 150 years were excluded. For each age class, the weighted mean of
the plot observations and its
`r scales::percent(bundle$manifest$validation$ci_level)` confidence interval
(CI) were compared with the mean RSYC prediction for the same plots. See
[Tompalski et al. (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1093/forestry/cpaf067) for more
details about model validation.


## Summary statistics {.tabset}


```{r summary-table, results = "asis"}
summary_table <- validation_summary_table(bundle)
for (y_var in response_names) {
  for (scale in scale_labels) {
    cat("###", y_var, "–", scale, "\n\n")
    summary_table %>%
      filter(Response == y_var, Scale == scale) %>%
      select(-Response, -Scale) %>%
      knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 1, 1)) %>%
      print()
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Observed vs predicted


```{r scatterplots, results = "asis"}
for (y_var in names(response_names)) {
  cat("###", response_names[[y_var]], "\n\n")
  for (scale in names(scale_labels)) {
    cat("####", scale_labels[[scale]], "models {.tabset}\n\n")
    for (level in spatial_levels) {
      points <- validation_points(bundle, y_var, scale, level)
      if (nrow(points) == 0) {
        next
      }
      n_panels <- n_distinct(points$species_name)
      cat("#####", spatial_labels[[level]], "\n\n")
      cat(
        sprintf(
          "%s age-class points from %s curves. [Map these curves](%s) in the curve explorer.\n\n",
          format(nrow(points), big.mark = ","),
          format(n_distinct(points$key), big.mark = ","),
          explorer_link(y_var, scale, level, metric = "ccc")
        )
      )
      knit_figure(
        validation_scatterplot(points, y_var),
        height = figure_height(n_panels, 1.87, 3.75),
        alt = sprintf(
          "Scatterplots of %s RSYC predictions against plot means for %s %s models, one panel per model.",
          response_names[[y_var]], scale, level
        )
      )
    }
  }
}
```
